cherries2 tbsp honey1 small bunch mint250g mascarponeToss the strawberries, blueberries and cherries with some honey and torn mint.Whip the mascarpone with a spoon of honey until soft.Serve the fruit in a bowl with the mascarpone alongside.Salacious Crumb's crispy chicken bitesFor Jabba's cackling sidekick, who'd steal them anywayHow to make itAs written, serves 4Buttermilk-brined chicken thigh nuggets in a garlic paprika crust, fried crisp and tossed in chilli salt, with a herby green mayo for dipping.Cut 700g chicken thighs into bite-size pieces and soak in 300ml buttermilk with 1 tsp salt for 2 hours.Mix 200g plain flour with 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika and pepper.Dredge the chicken and fry at 170°C for 5 minutes until crisp and cooked through.Toss in salt mixed with a pinch of chilli flakes.Blitz 120g mayo with a handful of parsley, chives and lemon juice for the dip.MainsEwok honey roast chickenSpatchcock chicken roasted over potatoes and carrots, glazed with honeyHow to make it1.8kg whole chicken800g potatoes4 carrots3 tbsp honey2 garlic cloves, crushed3 sprigs of thyme2 tbsp olive oilsalt and pepper, to tasteSpatchcock the chicken and cut the potatoes and carrots into chunks.Lay the chicken over the vegetables, season and drizzle with oil.Roast at 220°C.Warm the honey with the garlic and thyme, brush over and roast until glossy.Rest and pull apart to share.Jabba's sail barge smoked brisketA big slab of everything, served before the Sarlacc pitHow to make itAs written, serves 4Salt and pepper brisket smoked low until it wobbles, sliced thick with sticky barbecue sauce, tangy slaw, pickles and soft white bread.Rub a 2.5kg brisket with 2 tbsp coarse salt and 2 tbsp cracked pepper.Smoke or roast at 120°C for about 10 hours until 95°C inside, wrapping in baking paper once it reaches 70°C.Rest 1 hour.Shred quarter of a cabbage and 1 carrot and toss with 3 tbsp mayo and 1 tbsp cider vinegar.Slice the brisket thick and serve with barbecue
